## What's Changed

- Redesigned Local Media settings around Movies, TV Shows, Music, and Folders
  tabs with per-library controls and media statistics.
- Added a server-side folder browser so libraries can be configured without
  manually typing paths.
- Added a persistent incremental local-media index that reuses unchanged file
  metadata and reports movie, show, episode, artist, album, song, artwork, and
  storage totals.
- Added a music-library album view with search, missing-art filtering, artwork
  source details, and individual artwork management.
- Detects embedded artwork and common local cover files without modifying the
  original audio files.
- Added missing-art discovery through MusicBrainz and Cover Art Archive with
  bounded downloads, local caching, request pacing, and lockable selections.
- Added authenticated artwork URLs for local music album and track catalog
  results so paired Tater players can display the selected artwork.
- Added background scan status and progress reporting for library updates and
  artwork discovery.

## Upgrade

Pull the latest container and restart:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest
docker restart tater-tube-server
```

No database migration is required. Open **Configuration → Local Media**, save
your library folders, and run **Scan Libraries** once to build the new index.
Existing music files remain unchanged; generated indexes and downloaded artwork
are stored in Tater Tube's metadata directory.
